line_1_avatar_and_context.description: Prospect role, business/situation, lead source, and VSSL consumption status.

line_2_quantified_gap.description: Exact Current State vs. Desired State numbers.

line_3_core_pain_and_stakes.description: Primary obstacle plus attached dollar figure, timeline, or affected person.

line_4_bant_and_deal_breakers.description: Budget, Authority (all decision makers?), Need, Timing, plus logistics or value deal breakers.

line_5_predicted_objections_and_proof.description: Anticipated smoke screens/objections plus matched case studies or testimonials.

line_6_next_step_and_tone_intel.description: Exact BAMFAM/handoff slot, prospect communication style (needs challenge vs. back-foot), and required follow-up.
